data.name: Fleshbound Familiar
data.description: You gain a familiar, but the familiar gains the share powers ability instead of share spells.  In addition, when manifesting a psychometabolism power with a range of personal, you can expend your psionic focus and spend 2 additional power points to have that power also affect your familiar and not require the familiar to be within 5 feet of you.
